buyer_question: How do I reduce manual work in my factory without buying ERP first?
safe_aics_answer: Map order intake production stages material blockers dispatch handoff and payment follow-up into one owner dashboard before choosing ERP or custom software.
human_review_gate: Owner must confirm actual workflow fields users and reporting cadence before automation
claim_boundary: Synthetic readiness only; no real factory client savings productivity delivery or staff-reduction claim
next_step: Use the checklist to mark repeated handoffs and request a no-credentials factory workflow review

buyer_question: Our factory production follow-up is in Excel and WhatsApp what should we fix first?
safe_aics_answer: Turn repeated WhatsApp updates into structured status fields: order owner stage delay reason material dependency dispatch readiness and customer update.
human_review_gate: Do not ingest private customer supplier payroll finance or production-system data until scope is approved
claim_boundary: Readiness artifact only; not proof of automation ROI or operational improvement
next_step: Start with a one-week sample of non-sensitive status categories and owners

buyer_question: Should a small manufacturer use ERP task apps or custom automation?
safe_aics_answer: Use ERP when process maturity and adoption are ready; use task apps for generic assignments; use AICS-style evidence review when owner visibility and workflow boundaries are unclear.
human_review_gate: Owner must approve tool-fit decision criteria and unsafe claims before vendor comparison
claim_boundary: No vendor ranking partnership endorsement or implementation guarantee is claimed
next_step: Compare alternatives against owner dashboard adoption data and manual leak points

buyer_question: How can a factory owner see pending delayed and ready-to-dispatch orders daily?
safe_aics_answer: Define dashboard lanes for pending today delayed material-blocked quality-check packing dispatch customer-waiting and payment-follow-up items.
human_review_gate: Manager or owner must validate lane definitions and responsible people before build
claim_boundary: Demo/readiness guidance only; no real operational dashboard result is claimed
next_step: Use synthetic CSV headings to design a no-credentials owner dashboard wireframe

buyer_question: Can AI automate factory staff follow-up safely?
safe_aics_answer: AI can help summarize reminders and exception lists only after humans define sources owners stop-rules and review gates; start with admin/status automation not production control.
human_review_gate: Human review is required for safety-critical production decisions job-cut decisions financial commitments and customer promises
claim_boundary: No safety production employment legal compliance or AI-accuracy claim is made
next_step: Separate admin follow-up from production-control decisions before any AI workflow
